(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (build-grid 5
                       w
                       (r c)
                       (let ((top (at g r c))
                             (bot (at g (+ r 6) c)))
                         (if (!= bot 0) bot top))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (build-grid 5
                       w
                       (r c)
                       (let ((top (at g r c))
                             (bot (at g (+ r 6) c)))
                         (if (!= top 0) top bot))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
 (let* ((ph (quotient (- (rows g) 1) 2)) (w (cols g)) (off (- (rows g) ph))
        (tn (for*/sum ((r (range 0 ph)) (c (range 0 w))) (if (= (at g r c) 0) 0 1))) (bn (for*/sum ((r (range 0 ph)) (c (range 0 w))) (if (= (at g (+ off r) c) 0) 0 1)))
        (choose-top (> tn bn)))
  (build-grid ph w (r c)
   (let ((top (at g r c)) (bot (at g (+ off r) c)))
    (if choose-top (if (!= top 0) top bot) (if (!= bot 0) bot top)))))))
